a: $560,000 over 5 years (bridges the postdoc and early faculty years)
dt: 2027 LOI closed Aug 14, 2026; the full application is due Jan 11, 2027 for LOI submitters. The next LOI is expected around Aug 2027
e: For physical, mathematical, computational and engineering scientists who have moved into biology. Requires 12–60 months of postdoc experience and no tenure-track appointment held or accepted. Open to US/Canadian citizens, permanent residents and temporary residents with valid visas.
n: Burroughs Wellcome Fund Career Awards at the Scientific Interface (CASI)
